Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When the flowers appear, add one visual detail to make the setting easier to imagine, for example: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”
2. After 神农 realizes that some plants may be poisonous, add his worried thought, for example: “他想：这些植物真的能做药吗？”
3. At the final sentence, explain why he wants to put the flowers in tea, for example: “他想试一试这种花能不能做药。”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple visual detail to the flowers already mentioned without changing the story.
Shennong already thinks that the plants may be poisonous, so this repeats his doubt.
The learner already says that Shennong wants to find a plant that people can use as medicine.
